apps.summary: Fast, native code editor: a fork of Zed with an agents sidebar and the Ferrum theme.
highlights: Agent threads sidebar, open by default
Opens FerrumGIT, FerrumTerm, FerrumData and FerrumAPI from the editor
Ferrum Dark and Light themes; telemetry and auto-update off

apps.summary: Local-first, Postman-style API client. No backend, no account, no webview.
highlights: Collections, environments, Postman and cURL import, code generation
Collection runner with pass/fail per request
Cookie jar, response search and JSON colouring

apps.summary: Local-first Git client with a commit graph and per-project SSH profiles.
highlights: Virtualized commit graph with search across commits
File history, blame and side-by-side diffs
Undo for commit, amend and checkout; per-project SSH profiles

apps.summary: Local-first database IDE for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SurrealDB and MongoDB.
highlights: Five engines with read-only sessions and keychain passwords
Query history, CSV/JSON export and sortable, resizable grid
Column and index details for SQL tables

apps.summary: GPU terminal for humans and AI agents, with persistent server-side sessions.
highlights: Terminals live in a server: close the window, programs keep running
Sidebar with agents (Claude Code, Codex) and their live status
Start an agent in a new tab from the sidebar; mouse selection and copy

apps.summary: Installs, updates, rolls back and launches every Ferrum app.
highlights: Every version comes from GitHub Releases, with checksums verified
Stable and Beta update channels per app
Keeps several versions so you can switch back in one click
roadmap: Self-update that restarts into the new version
